newsitem.title: CHINA: Shun Cheong holders discuss stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Shun Cheong holders discuss stake sale.

text.p: Shun Cheong Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that substantial shareholders of the company were discussing the sale of a stake to King Task Development Ltd, a third party Hong Kong company with mainland connections.
"The directors of the company have no other knowledge of the identity of ownership or business of the third party or of its connection with mainland China," it said in a statement.

Shun Cheong said discussions with Chinney Investments Ltd, which holds about 18.46 percent of the company, New World Trading Ltd, which holds about 15.47 percent, and Yau Lee Holdings Ltd, which holds about 15 percent, were at a preliminary stage.

"It is uncertain, therefore, whether any such transactions will take place and, if they do, may or may not lead to a change in the control of the company," the electrical and mechanical engineering concern said.
Trading in Shun Cheong shares was suspended on Tuesday pending the announcement and was due to resume on Wednesday.
The stock last traded at HK$0.95.
